options.pitch: Who's clipping the margin? This time, the buyer. Infosys says clients now expect it to charge less when it uses AI, and those savings are baked into its multi-year deals; it cut its growth forecast to 1 to 2 percent and protected its margin at about 21 percent.
options.why_now: Infosys revised its forecast in results reported by The Register on 28 October 2026; your Future trend press of 3 November.

options.pitch: Oracle filed to raise $10 billion in shares and $10 billion in bonds on top of about $125 billion of debt, and says customer prepayments are part of how it reaches positive free cash flow in the second half of 2028. The AI build is funded by lenders, shareholders and, quietly, customers.
options.why_now: Oracle filed on 2 November 2026; its shares fell 8.8% that day (CNBC).

options.pitch: From December, ChatGPT Plus, Pro and Business plans share one token budget across chat and Codex: the flat AI subscription becomes a meter, and harder work drains it faster.
options.why_now: OpenAI's updated support page, reported by The Decoder on 1 November 2026; the change starts in December.

options.pitch: Anthropic took $16.96 billion in a quarter and still swung from a $974 million operating profit to a $567 million loss, partly from about $5 billion of short-notice computing that costs significantly more than its long contracts, with about $895 billion of future computing signed up.
